items.title: Prayer: Ask what faithfulness looks like now
items.body: Read Psalm 94:19 once, then again more slowly. Turn the passage into a three-part prayer: thank God for one truth you see, ask for help with one response the passage calls for, and surrender one outcome you cannot control. End by naming one person or situation you will carry before God today.

items.title: Share: Ask what faithfulness looks like now
items.body: Read Psalm 94:19 and notice one truth you could carry into a conversation. Write it in your own words without copying verse text, then think of one trustworthy person who could benefit from hearing what you learned. Ask one sincere question, listen first, and share the truth with humility if the moment is right.
